items.readme: Answers show their working. Every answer keeps the steps, the code that ran and what it printed. Nothing is a bare number. Forecasts earn their place. Each forecast is backtested against simple baselines on your own history, so you can see whether the model beats a naive guess. Runs on your machine. items.title: stt studio
items.summary: Local, optimised Whisper inference and a speech-to-text studio.
items.readme: STT Studio is an early-stage local speech-to-text workspace for Mac. It combines a FastAPI service running faster-whisper (and optionally mlx-audio on Apple Silicon) with a Vite/React interface. Select an audio file, choose a model and transcription settings, run a local job, then review, edit, search, copy, or export the transcript. It is a development project, not a packaged or production-ready application.

items.title: Quotient
items.readme: Quotient turns a recorded meeting or call into a written brief, a set of evidence-linked findings and follow-up actions. Every statement it publishes points to the moment in the recording where it was said. Statements it cannot confirm are held back for review rather than presented as fact.

Provider access and included usage depend on each account. It also exposes TypeSafe Jev as a separate Decisions API and native System One endpoint. items.title: Vietnamese Passport OCR Project with VietOCR
items.summary: Passport OCR with VietOCR and synthetic passports.
items.readme: This project implements an OCR (Optical Character Recognition) scanner for extracting key fields from passport images, such as fullname, dob (date of birth), country, pob (place of birth), gender, cmnd (Vietnamese ID number), nameid (VNM>YOUR>FULL>NAME) and passportid (passport number). The system leverages the power of VietOCR for training and testing on a custom dataset formatted in COCO-style annotations.
